fields.label: Title
fields.description: The announcement's headline, shown verbatim on the student's glance card

fields.label: Body
fields.description: The announcement text — one-way operator→student post (schedule changes, holiday programme news); there are no comments and no stream

fields.label: Subject
fields.description: Optional subject tag shown with the post (display context only — audience filtering is grade/curriculum)

fields.label: Grade
fields.description: Optional audience filter: only students with this stored grade see the post; empty means every grade

fields.label: Curriculum
fields.description: Optional audience filter: only students with this stored curriculum see the post (display-stable strings: CAPS, IEB, Cambridge, US Common Core); empty means every curriculum

fields.label: Starts At
fields.description: Optional window start — the post stays hidden until this moment; empty shows it immediately

fields.label: Ends At
fields.description: Optional window end (exclusive) — the post disappears at this moment; empty keeps it up until retired

fields.label: Retired
fields.description: Set by retire_announcement — takes the post off every glance card immediately, whatever its window

fields.label: Posted By
fields.description: The System Manager who posted it (create_announcement sets this from the session)
